title: Best OP Auto Queue Auto Requeue Auto Buy Live Stats
features:
Ronix Hub - 8 Ball Duels

Player Stats
- Live coins, level, skill rating and win rate on one page
- Wins, losses, win streak, session profit and session time, plus a Refresh Stats button

Auto Queue
- Auto Queue puts you in a match on the venue you pick
- Set a Wager up to 100,000 coins and pick a Casual, Tournament or Beginner ruleset
- Min Coins and Max Coins limits pause the queue when your balance is out of range
- Leaves and retries a queue after 2 minutes, unless Queue with Bot Only is on
- Auto Requeue after each match, a Leave Queue button, and live queue and match status

HUD Overlay
- Hide Native HUD tucks away the game's own match HUD

Auto Buy
- Auto Buy Cue Sticks, Tables and VFX on a timer while it is on
- Buy Wager Level slider from 1 to 50, and an Open Shop button for the cue shop

General
- Anti AFK on by default, and Auto Save Config every 60 seconds
- Save Config and Load Config buttons, plus Unload Script to close the hub cleanly
- Visuals: FPS Boost, No Particles, No Shadows, Clean FX and Hide Other Players
- Flat Materials and No Textures turn the map plain for smoother play on phones
- Auto Buy spends real coins, so check your balance before you turn it on

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
